title: Cross-Process Outcome Ledger + Neural Feedback Bus
brief: Close architect risk #1 (outcome data starvation). Every print-to-program pipeline run, consensus decision, and machine job must emit a structured CrossProcessOutcomeEvent that lands in CrossProcessOutcomeStore. Add a feedback bus so downstream learning engines (CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine, BayesianCalibrate, LoRA trainers) subscribe instead of poll.

shipped.title: extend OutcomeEventSchema to v1.1.0 (additive cross-process pipeline + consensus-audit fields)
shipped.scope_reconciliation: Per duplication-guard + user direction, EXTENDED existing outcomeEventSchema.ts (v1.0.0 → v1.1.0 backward-compat union) instead of creating parallel CrossProcessOutcomeEvent. Reuses NUMERIC_FEATURE_KEYS imported from CrossProcessOutcomeStore (single source of truth).
shipped.scrutiny: Per-file gate: 4 reviewer agents (2 per file × 2 files). 1 P0 + 4 P1 found, ALL fixed in same commit per always-close-out rule. Pre-existing MultiModelConsensusEngine breakage (alpha noted) not touched — vitest path doesn't import it.
deferred_followups: empty-string job_id boundary test (pickSchemaVersion uses !== undefined, would still trigger v1.1.0 stamp)
unicode/surrogate-pair length test (.max(128) counts UTF-16 units, not codepoints)
P1-2 v10Event() allocation efficiency in it.each (cosmetic — defer)

units.title: Define CrossProcessOutcomeEvent schema with schemaVersion + Zod validator
units.scope_note: Delivered as EXTENSION of existing outcomeEventSchema.ts (v1.0.0 → v1.1.0) per duplication-guard. Adds 4 optional context fields, 2 OutcomeKind values, optional numeric_features map, cross-field superRefine, convention-drift superRefine. 39 tests pass. See shipped[] entry for full details.
exit_conditions: Zod schema for {schemaVersion, ts, jobId, domain, pipelineStage, decision, predicted, actual, deltaMetrics, consensusAuditId?}
Numeric features validated (NUMERIC_FEATURE_KEYS list per existing pattern)
Migration path: schemaVersion 1.0.0 → 1.1.0 spec written
Tests: schema accepts valid event; rejects 5 malformed variants (missing required, wrong type, NaN, Infinity, oversize)
units.description: Reuse the existing NUMERIC_FEATURE_KEYS constant from CrossProcessOutcomeStore. Add jobId for cross-event linkage. consensusAuditId references entries in consensus-decisions.jsonl (ledger written by MS0).

units.title: Hook outcome emission into all 6 P2P pipeline engines
exit_conditions: MillingPrintToProgramEngine emits outcome at end of every run
TurningPrintToProgramEngine emits
WEDMPrintToProgramEngine emits
SinkerEDMPrintToProgramEngine emits
Laser/Waterjet emit (even if scaffolded — emit 'pipeline_skipped' status)
Emission is fire-and-forget (Promise.resolve, never blocks main path)
Tests: each engine emission validated against schema; emission failure logged but does not break pipeline
units.description: Insert a single line at the end of each engine's main run method: `crossProcessOutcomeStore.append(buildOutcome(this, result))`. Build a small helper that derives the event from engine state. No new dependency injection — direct singleton import per existing pattern.

units.title: CrossProcessOutcomeStore replay capability — reproduce last 100 jobs
exit_conditions: store.replay(limit) returns ordered events
store.replayJob(jobId) returns all events for a single job in order
store.replaySince(timestamp) returns events after a cutoff
Tests: write 200 events, replay last 100 returns correct slice; replay by jobId returns full chain; replaySince filters correctly
units.description: Read-side API for the ledger. Used by learning engines and audit dashboards. JSONL streaming reader; never load full ledger into memory.

units.title: Neural feedback bus — pub/sub for outcome events
exit_conditions: FeedbackBusEngine.subscribe(domain, callback) registers listeners
FeedbackBusEngine.publish(event) fires all matching subscribers async
Subscribers: CrossProcessNeuralLearningEngine, BayesianCalibrationEngine, CAMLoRAAdapterTrainerEngine wired
Tests: subscribe + publish round-trip; subscriber error does not prevent other subscribers; publish to non-existent domain is no-op
E2E: simulate a mill job, verify ALL 3 subscribers get the event
units.description: In-process event emitter (Node EventEmitter). Lightweight — not a queue. Future MS may add durability. Subscribers must be idempotent; bus does not retry.

acceptance: Every P2P run writes a structured outcome event; replay reproduces last 100 jobs in order; 3 learning engines receive events via feedback bus; schemaVersion gate live.

risks.description: Engine emission adds latency; mitigation = fire-and-forget Promise.resolve, never await
Ledger grows unbounded; mitigation = rotation at 100MB, archived to .gz
Subscriber crash propagates; mitigation = try/catch around each invocation in publish loop
